name: business-diagram
description: Generates a validated business or software diagram (architecture, workflow, sequence, data flow, lifecycle, or operating pillars) from this plugin. Docs at https://diagram.mosofin.com. Upstream project: MosoFin/mosofin-diagram.

chrome_path.title: Chrome executable path
chrome_path.description: Optional absolute path to Google Chrome or Chromium used only for visual-check screenshots. Leave empty to auto-detect standard install locations. Stored securely; not read from your shell environment.
